characters.name: Andy
characters.clueEn: He was alone with Iliana. He was north of her.
characters.clueZh:
他和Iliana单独在一起。
他在她的北边。

characters.name: Briggs
characters.clueEn: He was sitting in a chair.
characters.clueZh:
他坐在
一把椅子上。

characters.name: Carissa
characters.clueEn: Exactly three columns west of her, someone was in a car.
characters.clueZh:
在她正西边三列的地方，
有人在一辆车里。

characters.name: Donna
characters.clueEn: She was beside a wall, there was an empty area on the other side.
characters.clueZh: 她在一个空区域的边界旁边。

characters.name: Ezra
characters.clueEn: She was in an Elevator. There was a woman in the other Elevator.
characters.clueZh:
她在一部电梯里。另一部
电梯里有一个女人。

characters.name: Felicia
characters.clueEn: She was in a car or in the bus.
characters.clueZh:
她在一辆车里
或在公交车上。

characters.name: Greg
characters.clueEn: He was in the first or second column.

characters.name: Hayes
characters.clueEn: He was beside a potted plant. He was with Briggs.
characters.clueZh:
他在一盆盆栽旁边。
他和Briggs在一起。

characters.name: Iliana
characters.clueEn: She was on a Sidewalk. She was east of Donna.
characters.clueZh:
她在一条人行道上。
她在Donna的东边。

characters.name: Jimmy
characters.clueEn: He was alone on a Sidewalk.
characters.clueZh:
他独自
在一条人行道上。

characters.name: Kimberly
characters.clueEn: Two rows north of her, someone was beside a statue.
characters.clueZh:
在她北边两行的地方，
有人在一座雕像旁边。

characters.name: Virgil
characters.clueEn: The Victim. He was alone with the murderer.
characters.clueZh: 被害者。和凶手单独在一起。
